title: 第15章 地下城第16章 史莱姆娘
lines: “你怎么知道的？你到底是谁？”
“如你所见，是这家蜜语坊的老板。
姑且算是一位商人。”
格林优雅地行了一礼，“至于我怎么知道的，我想‘新生之光’还是很有名的，而我只要稍微了解一下就能知道她有哪些好朋友了。”
新生之光，指的是莉米露，她出生平民，却有着极其强大的光魔法天赋，于是被教会选为了圣女候选人。
因为十分优秀，莉米露被称为了新生之光，意思就是新一代最耀眼的存在。
让我们衷心感谢贞德小姐在闲聊时透露出来的信息。
贞德在和格林闲聊时曾提过她有一个妹妹，是一名魔法师。
这位妹妹也是一个圣女，她还有一个后辈，名叫莉米露。
贞德在说到这里的时候还提了一嘴，她也想要一个像莉米露这样优秀的后辈，可惜女骑士实在是太少太少了。
格林对贞德口中的人感到好奇，于是开始搜集情报，顺着莉米露这条线索一路查到了卡尔斯等人，以及他们在学院的事迹。
卡尔斯的不胜传说也是在那时候了解到的，
“一个商人知道得这么多？”
“并不多，我只是碰巧了解了一下而已。
你要是问其他信息，我还真不一定知道。”
格林随意地耸耸肩，这个时代的人对于自身信息的保护还是太弱了。
“所以，你们要给你们的朋友办理VIP吗？”
最终，两人跟着格林进入了店内，在格林的帮助下，两人很快帮莉米露注册了VIP。
临别的时候，两人又在格林的花言巧语下买了比计划中多得多的食物，直到回到住宿的酒店，他们才意识到很多时候他们都被格林牵着鼻子走了。
但也没有办法了，毕竟买都买了，而且蜜语坊的食物确实好吃，多买一点也没有什么。
卡尔斯在自己房间里放下了东西，朝着对面房间出声询问道：“埃莉诺，你还好吗？”
一道断断续续的声音从房间里面传来：
“还好，不过……我们可以等人少一点的时候再去吗？”
卡尔斯有些无奈地扶额，如果可以，他真的不想和这个怕生的家伙一起执行任务。
原因也很简单，他想要快点完成任务回到学校里去，在教会检查完之后再检查一遍完全是浪费时间。
而埃莉诺的怕生又极大延长了这一过程，让他感觉浪费的时间更多了。
但是他一个人又检查不了地下城，他可以探测有没有深渊节点残余，但是没有办法探测地下城的具体结构。
虽然可以糊弄了事，但是卡尔斯觉得既然被派发了任务，那么身为魔法塔传人的他就理应完成好任务，绝对不能糊弄了事。
至于为什么和埃莉诺组队，则是因为这是学生会会长抽签得出的，而学生会会长一般不会让别人更改她的决定。
没有办法卡尔斯只好吐槽了埃莉诺几句，然后回房间等埃莉诺调整好了再出发。
“今天又是那个老板的，又是埃莉诺的，没有一件事是让人省心的！”
“我记得……是这里吧？”
一道黑影从树林里钻出，看着一个还算大的坑洞，这个身影自然是格林。
content_en:
"How do you know? Who are you?"
“As you can see, he is the owner of this Sweet Talk Shop.
Let's call him a businessman. "
Green bowed gracefully, "As for how I know, I think 'New Light' is still very famous, and I only need to know a little bit about her to know who her good friends are."
The light of rebirth refers to Rimilu. She was born a commoner, but had extremely powerful light magic talent, so she was selected by the church as a candidate for sainthood.
Because she is so outstanding, Rimilu is called the Light of New Life, which means the most dazzling existence of the new generation.
Let us sincerely thank Miss Jeanne for the information she revealed in casual conversation.
When Joan of Arc was chatting with Green, she mentioned that she had a sister who was a magician.
This sister is also a saint, and she has a descendant named Limilu.
When Joan of Arc said this, she also mentioned that she also wanted an outstanding junior like Li Milu, but unfortunately there were too few female knights.
Green was curious about the person Joan of Arc was talking about, so he began to collect intelligence, and followed the clues of Li Milu to find out about Carls and others, as well as their deeds in the academy.
It was also at that time that I learned about the incredible legend of Kars.
"A businessman knows so much?"
“Not much, I just happened to know about it.
If you ask for other information, I really don’t necessarily know. "
Green shrugged casually. People in this era are still too weak in protecting their own information.
"So, do you want to apply for VIP for your friends?"
Finally, the two followed Green into the store. With Green's help, the two quickly helped Li Milu register for VIP.
When parting, the two of them bought much more food than planned under Green's rhetoric. It wasn't until they returned to the hotel where they were staying that they realized that they had been led by Green many times.
But there is no other way. After all, I bought everything, and the food in Miyufang is indeed delicious, so there is nothing wrong with buying more.
Karls put down his things in his room and asked in the opposite room: "Eleanor, are you okay?"
An intermittent voice came from inside the room:
"It's okay, but...can we wait until there are fewer people?"
Karls held his forehead helplessly. If possible, he really didn't want to go on a mission with this guy who was afraid of strangers.
The reason is also very simple. He wants to complete the task quickly and return to school. It is a complete waste of time to check again after the church inspection.
And Eleanor's fear of strangers greatly prolonged the process, making him feel that even more time was wasted.
But he couldn't check the dungeon by himself. He could detect whether there were any remnants of abyss nodes, but there was no way to detect the specific structure of the dungeon.
Although he can fool around, Karls feels that since he has been assigned a task, as the descendant of the Magic Tower, he should complete the task well, and he must not fool around.
As for why she teamed up with Eleanor, it was because it was drawn by the student council president, and the student council president generally would not let others change her decision.
There was no other way, so Karls had no choice but to complain to Eleanor a few words, then go back to the room and wait for Eleanor to adjust before setting off.
"Today it's the boss's and Eleanor's again. Nothing is worry-free!"
…
"I remember... it's here, right?"
A dark figure emerged from the woods, looking at a fairly large pothole. This figure was naturally Green.
